screens.title: Expedition Roster
screens.description: A three-member roster fragment uses rank, vitality, and stress as the visual hierarchy; stress is the only saturated red signal.

screens.title: Provision Counter
screens.description: A compact supply shelf presents quantity, silhouette, and cost with inked object marks instead of generic product tiles.

screens.title: Expedition Spoils
screens.description: A torn-paper reward choice gives one heirloom a clear selection state while keeping the action rail separate.

limitations: The crowquill and stress grammar is an authored interpretation of the plan and official store text, not a frame-accurate recreation of the game UI.
All visible figures, objects, ornaments, and SVG art are original vector studies; no game screenshots, character portraits, or official fonts are included.
The three specimens show component anatomy only. Screen behavior, game-state wiring, engine integration, and independent use testing remain for later work.

componentCapture.scope: Parent-reviewed component rendering; independent full-screen usage follows.
